author: ALMULLA
quote: Great visuals ruined by 30 FPS and boring, slow missions, this doesn’t feel like GTA. The graphics look amazing, but none of that matters when the game is locked to 30 FPS or below!!. No matter how hard you try to get into it, the choppy frame rate ruins the experience. On top of that, they completely changed the gameplay pacing for the worse. So far, most of the missions feel like pointless errands and dull busywork. The worst part is when you have to go to the bar with Lucia walking around talking to people, sitting down, and doing nothing. Where is the fun in that? Is this supposed to be a game?There is way too much of this slow filler packed into the story. It just doesn't feel like GTA.

quote: Graphics is not impressive specially for console exclusive there are hardly any improvments from last gen. quote:
